mapper.sql: CASE WHEN gsl.biz_type = 1 THEN rs.order_date WHEN gsl.biz_type = 2 THEN DATE(IFNULL(pr.payment_date, pr.create_time)) WHEN gsl.biz_type = 3 THEN so.order_date WHEN gsl.biz_type = 4 THEN DATE(IFNULL(sr.payment_date, sr.create_time)) WHEN gsl.biz_type = 5 THEN DATE(IFNULL(ro.payment_date, ro.create_time)) WHEN gsl.biz_type = 6 THEN DATE(IFNULL(rr.payment_date, rr.create_time)) WHEN gsl.biz_type IN (7, 8) THEN DATE(ts.create_time) WHEN gsl.biz_type = 10 THEN DATE(sas.create_time) WHEN gsl.biz_type = 11 THEN DATE(sto.create_time) ELSE NULL END

SELECT gsl.id, gsl.product_id, gsl.sc_id, gsl.ori_stock_num, gsl.cur_stock_num, gsl.ori_tax_price, gsl.cur_tax_price, gsl.stock_num, gsl.tax_amount, gsl.create_by, gsl.create_time, gsl.biz_id, gsl.biz_code, gsl.biz_detail_id, gsl.biz_type, DATE_FORMAT((), '%Y-%m-%d') AS order_date FROM tbl_product_stock_log AS gsl INNER JOIN base_data_product AS g ON g.id = gsl.product_id LEFT JOIN base_data_product_brand AS b ON b.id = g.brand_id LEFT JOIN base_data_product_category AS c ON c.id = g.category_id LEFT JOIN tbl_receive_sheet AS rs ON rs.id = gsl.biz_id AND gsl.biz_type = 1 LEFT JOIN tbl_purchase_return AS pr ON pr.id = gsl.biz_id AND gsl.biz_type = 2 LEFT JOIN tbl_sale_out_sheet AS so ON so.id = gsl.biz_id AND gsl.biz_type = 3 LEFT JOIN tbl_sale_return AS sr ON sr.id = gsl.biz_id AND gsl.biz_type = 4 LEFT JOIN tbl_retail_out_sheet AS ro ON ro.id = gsl.biz_id AND gsl.biz_type = 5 LEFT JOIN tbl_retail_return AS rr ON rr.id = gsl.biz_id AND gsl.biz_type = 6 LEFT JOIN tbl_take_stock_sheet AS ts ON ts.id = gsl.biz_id AND gsl.biz_type IN (7, 8) LEFT JOIN tbl_stock_adjust_sheet AS sas ON sas.id = gsl.biz_id AND gsl.biz_type = 10 LEFT JOIN tbl_sc_transfer_order AS sto ON sto.id = gsl.biz_id AND gsl.biz_type = 11
